faq.a: Any student, teacher, or staff member can reserve items in the catalog. Items marked “Needs approval” are reviewed by an administrator before they are confirmed. Teachers can also approve room bookings.

faq.q: Why does my reservation say “Awaiting approval”?
faq.a: High-value equipment and large spaces are checked by staff so they are used safely. You will see the decision in My Activity, usually within one school day.

faq.q: How far ahead can I book, and for how long?
faq.a: You can book up to 30 days in advance, Monday through Friday, between 7:00 AM and 6:00 PM. Each resource lists its maximum booking length.

faq.q: How do I cancel or return something?
faq.a: Open My Activity and select Cancel on any upcoming reservation. For equipment, select Mark returned when you drop it off so the next person knows it is back.

faq.q: What if equipment is broken or a room has a problem?
faq.a: Submit a service request with the location and details. You will get a tracking number and can follow every status update on the Requests page.

faq.q: Can I create an account or sign in with Google?
faq.a: Yes. Choose your school, then select Continue with Google on the sign-in screen. The first time, this creates your Commons account. Your Google email still needs to be on a domain your school has approved.

faq.q: How will an administrator contact me about a request?
faq.a: Administrators can message you about any service request or reservation. Messages show up in My Activity under the Messages tab, and a number appears next to My Activity when you have unread ones.
This version saves data in your browser so it works without an account. A district deployment would connect the same interface to a secure database with school sign-in.

policies: Return equipment to its listed location by the end time of your reservation.

Report damage right away through a service request. Accidental damage is never penalized when it is reported.
Students reserving spaces after 3:30 PM must list a supervising staff member in the purpose.
